contaminationNote: The six-measure holdout contains Booking ground truth but no paired Expedia 3-star production-anchor observation. The scorer uses each observed Booking three-star value as the prediction anchor, so any result downstream of that value is contaminated: three-star accuracy, cost-band agreement, and the three-star component of category ranking/no-regression are not evaluable. The conditional ladder errors remain valid because they test the other rungs given a correct anchor.

threeStar.reason: The observed three-star Booking value is used as the prediction anchor; 0% APE is self-comparison.

gate2TierAccuracy.note: The frozen six-measure holdout supports four conditional ladder tiers. The three-star row is not evaluable because it is both observed ground truth and the prediction anchor. Food, drink and activity product tiers are not present in the ground-truth contract.

accommodationCategory.basis: sum of the five accommodation measures available in each holdout city; this is the accommodation-category component only
accommodationCategory.note: Upper bound only: the observed three-star Booking row is the dominant term in this sum and is also used as the prediction anchor. This is not an end-to-end ranking measurement without a paired Expedia production-anchor observation.

foodCategory.reason: No food measures in the frozen ground-truth panel.

totalDailyCost.reason: The panel has no food or drink measures for a full daily basket.

contaminatedRawResult.basis: candidate 3-star anchor compared with manifest cost bands

gate4CostBandAgreement.reason: The candidate three-star value is the holdout observation itself; banding it against the manifest cannot test the production anchor or the method.

gate5TripLevelRealism.reason: The six-measure panel does not contain the food and drink inputs required to compose a daily trip total.

threeStar.reason: The candidate three-star value is the holdout observation itself; its 0% APE and improvement versus v1 are not a method test.

gate6NoRegressionVsV1.requirement: 15 of 19 tiers improved with no tier regressing by more than 10%; three-star is not evaluable and the full gate cannot be evaluated from the six-measure panel.

developmentFit.groundTruthSource: Booking.com v2 development panel, displayed AUD
developmentFit.rawBasis: Expedia USD or documented bare-dollar proxy converted with the frozen USD→AUD snapshot; the offset absorbs the common source/display basis.

gate8CalibrationIntegrity.reason: The sealed holdout contains Booking ground truth but no paired Expedia production-anchor observation.

attractionCoverage.note: Activities cannot be validated from this panel: only 6 of 15 holdout attraction rows were found.
